<div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5003"/><div sID="gen7401" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5003"/>5. "Look up even unto the moon" (<reference osisRef="Job.15.15">Job 15:15</reference>). "Stars" here answer to "saints" (angels) there; "the moon" here to "the heavens" there. Even the "stars," the most dazzling object to man's eye, and the angels, of which the stars are emblems (<reference osisRef="Job.4.18">Job 4:18</reference>; <reference osisRef="Rev.9.1">Re 9:1</reference>), are imperfect in His sight. Theirs is the light and purity but of creatures; His of the Creator. <div eID="gen7401" type="x-p"/>
